```{r, echo = FALSE} 
numericInput("n",
"How many cars?", 5)
renderTable({
head(cars, input$n)
})


# widget is numeric input(variable, title, etc)
# second part the rendertable is the code observing changes and runs the head
# command for cars with the input number
```
